snippets.INSTRUCTION_TEXT: 1) Look at all the images carefully, then listen to the Spanish word or phrase. 2) Repeat the Spanish word or phrase out loud. 3) Which image belongs to the spoken Spanish word or phrase? Click on the correct one. 4) Repeat the Spanish word or phrase out loud again using the same pronunciation. 5) Then move on to the next question. Click on this button to go further.
snippets.INSTRUCTION_TEXT2: Using the images, you will look, hear and speak - this way you will learn Spanish all by yourself. This game is not about being the best or gaining the most points.
snippets.INSTRUCTION_TEXT4: In Level 1, there is 5 points per correct answer. In Level 2 there is 10 points per correct answer. In Level 3, there is 15 points per correct answer.
